answer: The mesa counter is kept in delta and zenith exposes each reset. Anyone hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 12 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 12 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3335 identities would post 3718 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
